title: go.mod marks the directly imported SQLite driver as // indirect
evidence: go.mod:15 `modernc.org/sqlite v1.60.0 // indirect` but store.go:7 imports `_ "modernc.org/sqlite"` directly; every require in go.mod:5-16 is tagged indirect
suggestion: Run `go mod tidy` so the direct dependency is listed without the // indirect marker

title: README states Go 1.22+ but go.mod requires Go 1.26.6
suggestion: Make the README prerequisite match the go directive, or lower the go directive to the version the code actually needs (1.22 for method-pattern ServeMux)

title: Tests discard json.Unmarshal errors
evidence: main_test.go:42, main_test.go:56, main_test.go:76, main_test.go:77 call json.Unmarshal without checking the returned error
suggestion: Fail the test when the response body does not decode, so a malformed body is reported as such rather than as a zero-value mismatch

title: Statement coverage is 75.2%; process entry point and 500 paths are not exercised
evidence: scores.json test_coverage=0.752; main.go:155-172 (main, getenv) and main.go:38-41 (serverErr) have no test in main_test.go
suggestion: Optional: add a test for getenv and a store-failure case (e.g. closed DB) to cover the 500/503 branches

title: Enhancements beyond spec: Location header, DB-pinging health check, body size limit, year and id validation
evidence: main.go:90 sets Location on 201; main.go:73 health calls Store.Ping and returns 503 on failure; main.go:46 io.LimitReader 1 MiB; main.go:57 rejects negative year; main.go:65 rejects non-numeric or <1 ids with 400
